contact.full_name: SAMIKSHA KHOTRE Client Implementation & Onboarding | Middle Office Operations | Trade Operations & Asset Servicing, Treasury Operations

data.summary:
Investment Banking & Middle Office Operations, Trade Operations, Treasury Operations professional with 6+ years of experience across Capital market, Client Implementation, Client Onboarding, Wealth & Portfolio Management, Global Treasury Operations, and Trade & Asset Servicing within Global Capital Markets. Proven track record managing liquidity management, liquidity structuring, treasury solutions, and cross-border payment processing (WIRE, ACH, NACHA), alongside end-to-end trade capture, clearing & settlement, break resolution, and reconciliation (Cash, Position, Nostro, OTC) across Equity, Fixed Income, Bonds, Derivatives, and FX. Skilled in leading client migration and onboarding projects, UAT testing, BRD/FRD authoring, and JIRA-driven delivery, with strong stakeholder management across Front, Middle & Back Office, Prime Brokers, and Custodians in a regulatory- aligned, controls-focused environment.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Led Client Implementation and Client Onboarding for institutional clients, coordinating Wealth & Portfolio Management, Assets Management, and Global Treasury Operations to ensure accurate, compliant client outcomes.
Delivered Liquidity Management and Liquidity Structuring solutions and drove Client Migration projects, stabilizing daily operations during high-volume periods and reducing recurring trade breaks.
Trained and mentored new hires and led a workstream to standardize break-resolution procedures, improving team consistency and turnaround time.
Authored BRD & FRD documentation and supported UAT Testing tracked via JIRA, translating business requirements into functional specifications for platform migrations.
Acted as primary escalation point for complex client queries, partnering directly with Prime Brokers and Custodians to protect SLAs.

raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Treasury & Payments: Global Treasury Operations, Liquidity Management, Liquidity Structuring, Cross-Border Treasury Solutions, Real-Time & Cross-Border Payments, Bank Reconciliation, WIRE, ACH, NACHA, Banking Operations.
Client Wealth & Portfolio Management: Client Implementation, Client Onboarding, Client Migration, Wealth Management Support, Assets Management, Account Opening & Maintenance, Portfolio Servicing, KYC/Due-Diligence Coordination
Trade & Settlement Operations: Trade Life Cycle, Trade Capture & Confirmation, Booking, Affirmation & Confirmation, Clearing & Settlement, Trade Finance, T+0/T+1/T+2 Settlement Cycles, Fails Management, Break Resolution & Root Cause Analysis
Reconciliation & Asset Servicing: Cash & Position Reconciliation, Nostro Reconciliation, OTC Reconciliation, Hedge Fund Accounting, NAV Calculation, Corporate Actions Processing, Fund Reconciliation
Asset Classes: Equity, Capital Markets, Bonds, Fixed Income, Derivatives, FX (Foreign Exchange), Credit Rating
Business & Project Support: Business Requirement Gathering, BRD/FRD Documentation, UAT Testing, Process Improvement, Quality Control & Audit Support, Stakeholder Management, SLA Management, MIS Reporting.
Financial Markets & Payments: Equity, Capital Markets, Bonds, Derivatives, FX (Foreign Exchange), Payment Transactions, Bank Reconciliation, Payment Processing, Real-Time Payments, WIRE, ACH, NACHA.
Tools & Platforms: JIRA, UAT, GENEVA, TLM, Bloomberg, MCH, Aladdin, Treasury Edge, Nexen, Pega, Refinitiv, DTCC, SWIFT, Omega CTM, Oasys, Calypso, Visio, Advanced Excel, VBA, Basic SQL, Power BI
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Associate — Client Implementation | BNY Mellon — Pune, India Oct 2024 – Jan 2026 • Delivered end-to-end Client Implementation and Client Onboarding services for institutional clients, coordinating across Front,
Middle, and Back Office to ensure seamless account setup and service delivery.
Managed Wealth and Portfolio Management services including assets management, account opening, and end-to-end portfolio servicing to support accurate reporting and client satisfaction.
Supported Global Treasury Operations and Capital Markets functions spanning cash management, liquidity, payments, and reconciliations for institutional clients across multiple regions.
• Drove Liquidity Management, Liquidity Structuring, and Treasury Solutions initiatives aligned with client and regulatory
requirements across cross-border treasury operations.
Led Client Migration and Client Onboarding projects as central point of coordination across Front, Middle, and Back Office stakeholders, delivering a lockbox setup project with zero disruption.
Processed and validated real-time and cross-border payment transactions across both international and domestic payment processing channels (WIRE, ACH, NACHA), performing bank reconciliation to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Provided business support on client-facing projects, gathering requirements and coordinating with stakeholders through delivery to align solutions with payment processing needs.
Supported UAT testing for platform migrations and system enhancements, logging and tracking items via JIRA to ensure quality delivery.
Authored BRD and FRD documentation, translating business requirements into functional specifications to guide platform migrations.
Directed Hedge Fund Accounting NAV calculations, net asset valuations, and banking operations activities including clearing, settlement, cash, and position reconciliation across Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and FX asset classes.
Senior Analyst — Hedge Fund Services, Middle Office Operations | Northern Trust — Pune, India Sep 2021 – Oct 2024 • Delivered end-to-end Trade Support across the complete Trade Life Cycle — booking, affirmation, confirmation, clearing, and
settlement — for listed and OTC products.
Managed Trade Capture, Confirmation, Fails Management, and Break Resolution for listed products, ensuring timely T+0/T+1/T+2 trade validation with Prime Brokers and custodians.
Handled trade booking, amendments, pricing updates, and allocations via Omega CTM and Oasys, supporting mark-to-market (MTM) processing across the trade life cycle.
Provided trade operation support and clearing & settlement services across Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Trade Finance instruments, maintaining clean books and records.
Owned resolution of cash and position breaks and aged-item escalations, acting as key liaison across Front Office, Middle Office, and Prime Brokers.
Directed derivative and cash balance management, fund accounting, and fixed income processing while identifying team-level risks and implementing process controls that stabilized operations.
Trained new hires on trade capture, confirmation, and break-resolution workflows, accelerating ramp-up to independent case handling.
Senior Analyst — Middle Office Operations | State Street — Pune, India Aug 2019 – Aug 2021 • Executed end-to-end Reconciliation across Cash and Position, Bank Reconciliation, Nostro, and OTC products for hedge fund
clients, performing daily reconciliations with custodians.
Managed the full trade life cycle including confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation across Derivatives, Fixed Income, and Capital Markets instruments, alongside hedge fund accounting responsibilities.
Used TLM for cash balance matching and OTC derivatives reconciliation, contributing to process migration projects supporting end-to-end global client services.
Built strong working knowledge of Capital Markets, Equity, Bonds, and Derivatives, applying this understanding to daily reconciliation and settlement activities.
